articles.title: Olivia Wilde on her Boston-area roots, her love of Diane Keaton, and the discomfort of ‘The Invite’
articles.description:
Actress Olivia Wilde, who got her start putting on shows at Phillips Academy in Andover, explains why it's so fun to play a character struggling to "keep their s*** together" in "The Invite."

The post Olivia Wilde on her Boston-area roots, her love of Diane Keaton, and the discomfort of ‘The Invite’ appeared first on Boston.com.
